documents.title: Acme Corp — Webex Calling + Control Hub renewal
documents.content: Legal flagged exclusive multi-year terms. Counsel described vendor lock-in fears and asked for exit clauses. Similar to last year's Acme campus Wi-Fi refresh. Notes mention procurement wants price-hold and FedRAMP evidence.

documents.title: Call notes — Acme general counsel
documents.content: GC: we cannot accept perpetual commitments. Legal concerns around switching costs if we standardize on one collaboration stack. They used the phrase 'we are worried about being stuck' more than 'lock-in'.

documents.title: Globex — Meraki + ThousandEyes overlay
documents.content: Network refresh for 140 branches. Buyer is infrastructure, not legal. Price sensitivity on AP density. No counsel involvement yet.

documents.title: Initech — Webex for Government
documents.content: FedRAMP High path. Security questionnaire references data residency US Gov East + West. Counsel wants audit trails on who searched what. Similar motion to Acme but security-led rather than commercial legal.

documents.title: Acme — 6 month transaction rollup
documents.content: Snowflake fact table: 14 Webex Calling seat expansions, 2 Control Hub add-ons, 1 professional services SOW. Payload pointers to 8.4 MB XML invoices in S3. Account id ACME-4419.

documents.title: Acme invoice pack — Q2 professional services
documents.content: Large unstructured payload (~10 MB equivalent in lab). Line items: Webex Calling migration, number porting, analog adapter replacements. Hidden in XML: 'counsel requested termination for convenience'. Keyword search on invoice ID misses this; semantic search surfaces legal language inside the payload.

documents.title: Order orchestration log — ACME-4419
documents.content: Elastic log: MuleSoft flow order-create retried 3x. Downstream CCW reservation delayed. Not a legal document — ops signal that the deal is stuck in provisioning, not in counsel.

documents.title: QBR recording — Acme collaboration owners
documents.content: Transcript excerpt: 'We like Webex quality but legal is nervous about being unable to unwind. Same conversation as the slide deck they sent — vendor lock-in fears, not product complaints.' Multimodal: deck screenshots + audio + notes should share one vector space.

documents.title: Acme counsel slide — 'switching costs'
documents.content: Slide OCR: Switching costs · exclusive term · data escrow. Image of a lock icon. No occurrence of the words 'legal concerns' — only 'switching costs'. Jina v5 multimodal is why this matches a text query about legal concerns.

documents.title: Umbrella Corp — legal hold on email archive
documents.content: This deal is about e-discovery legal hold, not collaboration lock-in. Keyword 'legal' matches loudly. Semantic ranking should demote it when the query is about vendor lock-in fears on a Webex renewal.

documents.title: CCR + local search — US Gov East / West
documents.content: Cross-cluster replication keeps Webex and CRM indices in both gov regions. Search locally with the same synonyms and ranking. Do not send queries across the US-Gov boundary at query time.
